successCriteria.description: `web/` is a standalone Vite project (own package.json + tsconfig, NOT under src/) whose `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit + vite build) completes with zero TypeScript errors and produces a production bundle.

`web/src/shared/types/index.ts` exports exactly the canonical types with the exact field shapes: EmployeeRole, LeaveTypeCode, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, AuthSessionStatus, EmployeeProfile (10 fields), LeaveBalanceView (9 fields), LeaveRequestView (14 fields), LoginResponse — no renamed, split, added, or omitted fields.
`web/src/shared/date/index.ts` exports `formatUtcDate(value: Date | string): string` (Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone 'UTC') and `parseUtcDate(value: string): Date` (ISO parsed as UTC).

Vitest unit tests exist for the enum member sets (each enum's exact members asserted) and for the date formatter: a UTC date string renders the same day under a non-UTC host TZ (test sets TZ to a non-UTC zone and asserts the day does not shift).

The Vite dev server proxies `/auth`, `/employees`, `/leaves`, `/balances` to the local backend on port 3000, and `web/index.html` + `web/src/main.tsx` mount a React root (placeholder acceptable; router wiring is Phase 5).

constraints: The web frontend is a NEW top-level `web/` directory with its own package.json/tsconfig — it must NOT inherit or modify the backend build config (root package.json, root tsconfig, src/). No files under src/ may be modified.
Dependencies are limited to React, React DOM, React Router, Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, and Testing Library. No UI component library and no state-management library.
web/tsconfig.json uses strict: true (implying noImplicitAny and strictNullChecks), jsx: react-jsx, and moduleResolution: bundler.

The shared-types module must define the canonical types EXACTLY as specified — no renaming, splitting, adding, or omitting any field; the code agent chooses only the implementation shape (e.g. union type vs enum), not the type names or field shapes.
Date rendering must go through the single shared formatter `formatUtcDate` (Intl.DateTimeFormat, timeZone 'UTC'). Never use bare `new Date(...)` local getters and never string-slice the ISO date.
The web project uses Vitest (jsdom environment, setup file) as its test runner — not the backend's Jest — and the `test` script runs vitest.
outOfScope: Router wiring, pages, guards, and any presentation components (Phase 5) — main.tsx may mount a placeholder only.
API client, token storage, auth module, and employee/leave/balance services (Phases 2–4) — no HTTP calls or session handling in this phase.
Any modification to files under src/ (backend) — the backend build and its tests must remain untouched.

entityInvariants.invariant: A read-only view of the signed-in employee with exactly 10 fields; it never carries passwordHash or terminationDate.
A read-only balance view with exactly 9 fields; `available` is display-only (entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays), never persisted or mutated by the frontend.
A read-only leave request view with exactly 14 fields; the frontend performs no state transitions (no create/submit/approve/reject/cancel).
A frontend-only enum with exactly the members ANONYMOUS | AUTHENTICATED | EXPIRED; it is not part of the backend shared types.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Renders the value's UTC calendar day via Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone 'UTC'; the rendered day must be identical regardless of the host/browser timezone.
Parses an ISO date string as a UTC instant (no local-timezone interpretation); the resulting Date's UTC components must match the string's date.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The frontend shared types must match the backend's canonical type shapes and enum member sets exactly (EmployeeRole, LeaveTypeCode, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, EmployeeProfile, LeaveBalanceView, LeaveRequestView, LoginResponse), so the wire contract is identical.

The frontend shared types and date module must be consistent with the reconciled web architecture's entity shapes and module boundaries (shared-types owns the enums/views; shared-date owns formatUtcDate/parseUtcDate).

The frontend date formatter must implement the UTC-rendering binding rule (Intl.DateTimeFormat timeZone 'UTC' via a single shared module) — distinct from the backend-only date helpers in src/shared/date/, which are not copied into web/.

integrationPoints.target: Backend Fastify API on port 3000 (POST /auth/login, GET /employees/me, GET /leaves, GET /leaves/:id, GET /balances/me)
integrationPoints.why: The Vite dev proxy targets this API; the frontend's shared types mirror its wire contract ({ error, code } errors, statuses 400/401/403/404/409/500).
